requirement_structuring.structuring_summary: Requirement R-Q-2 contains no linguistic ambiguities but exhibits concern-mixing (functional action + quality criterion). Per Pohl §25.2, it has been decomposed into a functional requirement (inform the security service) and a quality requirement (response time ≤ 2 s).

source_fragments: The system shall inform the security service
structured_requirements.final_statement: After detecting damage, the system shall inform the security service.
structuring_notes: Extracted the core functional action. The time constraint was separated.

structured_requirements.final_statement: The notification to the security service shall occur within 2 s of damage detection.
structuring_notes: Extracted the quality criterion (response time) as a separate artefact. The glossary definition 'Maximum accepted elapsed time' confirms the measurable nature of 'within 2 s'.
